transform_rules: Match tables by original caption/table name and header; indices identify the unmodified source only.
Match common rows by exact field name, exact PostgreSQL type, exact constraints/default text, and exact meaning; never match by field name alone.
Append codes in original row order to each table caption; do not insert an additional paragraph below every caption.
Remove precisely the matched 156 data rows. Retain every unmatched row in its original order, all 43 existing tables, all table captions, all enum values and all supplementary constraints.
Insert the 18 complete definitions once, with all four source cell values unchanged. The code adds an extra column or prefixed cell; it is not a database identifier.
Do not renumber B-3 through B-45: FKn resolves to the existing B-n table number.
Retain 10.5pt schema text and 13.5pt exact line height; retain body 12pt and current body line height.
Preserve SEQ versus ID, uuid versus integer/bigserial, FK7 versus nullable FK7, and CASCADE versus NO ACTION as distinct profiles.
Use a caption keepNext chain only through table header and first complete data row; keep each row indivisible; permit a continuation only when a table exceeds available page capacity.
After writing, reconstruct inherited and explicit rows using original ordinal positions from this JSON and compare every four-cell tuple; do not validate by displayed row count alone.

layout.table_page_policy: Prefer whole compact tables; avoid forcing every table onto a new page. Prevent isolated caption/header while permitting large tables to continue with repeated headers.

limits: This is a reversible format proposal, not a rendered result. Page savings must be checked in a pilot render; do not promise six pages from column widths alone. Added caption lines and the common-definition table reduce the nominal saving.
